title: dev.mdbase.reader.settings 1.0.0
description: Collection-wide settings that every mdbase Reader client honours. Every field is optional and has a default, so a record with none of them behaves like no record at all.

app.description: Marks this record as mdbase Reader's settings.

scope.description: These settings apply to everyone using Reader in this collection.

settings_version.description: The version of these settings that last wrote the record. Reader 1 writes 1.

source_name_template.description: A Knap template for the file name of a new source note, chapters included, without .md. A / starts a folder under sources/. Only new sources use it; existing files are never renamed.

annotation_name_template.description: A Knap template for the file name of a new annotation under annotations/, without .md. Only new annotations use it; existing files are never renamed.
